testCases.title: Submit form with all required fields empty
testCases.expectedResult: Validation errors shown for each required field

testCases.title: Required field indicators visible
steps: Check that required fields are marked with asterisk or other indicator
testCases.expectedResult: All required fields are clearly marked

testCases.title: Submit form with all fields filled correctly
steps: Fill all fields with valid data
testCases.expectedResult: Form submits successfully, success message or redirect

testCases.title: Phone number field format
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error shown, only valid phone format accepted

testCases.title: Max length limits respected
steps: Enter text exceeding max length in each text field
testCases.expectedResult: Input is either truncated or error message shown

testCases.title: Special characters in text fields
steps: Enter special chars: <script>, quotes, slashes in text fields
testCases.expectedResult: Characters are escaped or sanitized, no XSS, form handles gracefully
